# MTV AI-DLC Instructions

This project uses MTV AI-DLC (AI-Driven Development Lifecycle) methodology.

## Available prompts

Use the AI-DLC prompts in .github/prompts/ with the `aidlc.{phase}.{command}` naming pattern.

## Shared Claude assets

The Copilot installation also manages shared AI-DLC assets in:
- .claude/agents/
- .claude/skills/

## Workflow

1. Foundation: Analyze the project and establish context
2. Inception: Define requirements, units, and risks
3. Construction: Design, implement, test, and review
4. Operations: Report progress and roadmap outcomes
